7	## 0. Investigation summary (the four questions asked)
8	
9	**(1) Semicontinuity substrate.** Mathlib has NO cohomology-and-base-change / h⁰-semicontinuity, and none is needed: the project's single audited openness engine is `datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing` (`AlgebraicJacobian/Cohomology/GluedSheafEngine.lean:221`, Noetherian-free), already packaged in exactly the shape needed as `isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation` (`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean:321`): for a class `μ` over affine `A` **with a presenting datum `D` over `A`**, the set `{t | IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)}` is open. `Module.rankAtStalk` local constancy is not needed — the rank-1/finite/projective certificates come pointwise from residue witnesses via `RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum` (`Cohomology/RankOneFamilyCertificatesActualDatum.lean:107`).
10	
11	**(2) Propagation of H¹-vanishing/h⁰ from a point.** Fully landed as the two-way pointwise dictionary: `isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_tower` (`Picard/Pic0ChartPlusFibreTower.lean:215`) turns the witness-free plus-class identity `IsChartDatumPlusFibre` (supplied unconditionally for a datum's own class by `isChartDatumPlusFibre_of_relPicToPicEt`, `Picard/Pic0ChartPlusFibreProducer.lean:156`) into the full `IsChartDatumPresentation` iff. Field-location independence of the witness predicate is `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` (`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:142` — *any* field extension, both directions).
12	
13	**(3) The landed openness pattern.** The route of record is: engine openness over the étale carrier (`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing`, `Picard/Pic0ChartLocusOpen.lean:80`) → transport down `Spec B → Spec A` by `isOpen_of_isOpen_comap_preimage` (`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusOpen.lean:129`) → general test by affine-piece locality (`isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal`, `Picard/Pic0ChartLocusGeneralTest.lean:191`, iso-invariance discharged in `Picard/Pic0ChartLocusIsoInvariance.lean:263`). This plan clones that template for the untwisted rank-one split locus.
14	
15	**(4) Can the translated-cover structure avoid semicontinuity?** No. `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` (`Picard/Pic0SigmaSheaf.lean:161`) consumes `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i)` **per chart** plus joint local surjectivity. The translated-cover lane (`Picard/Pic0RankOneTranslatedCoverMembership.lean:60`) supplies coverage (membership of translates), not chart openness; openness of the one canonical rank-one chart *is* `PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi` — the gate this task discharges. So the fibre-locus construction below is unavoidable, but it is the only missing openness.
16	
17	**Honest structural finding about the deliverable's shape.** `EvaluationDivisorPullback` is **not provable for an arbitrary** `E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi`: its universal property forces `E.divisor.app (rankOneAbelSigma.app v') = v'` on all compatible values, i.e. (cofinally) `E.AbelInverse` (`Pic0RankOneFibrePresentedProducer.lean:96`), which `PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData` deliberately does not contain. Thread `hE : E.AbelInverse` as a hypothesis (it belongs to the E-producer lane). Also record the E-free fallback endpoint: the same construction feeds `picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented` (`Picard/Pic0RankOneLocus.lean:177`) with **no** `E` at all.
18	
19	Throughout: `hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom` must be threaded (the engine requires it). No Noetherian hypothesis is needed on this lane. Standard file preamble: the variable block of `Picard/Pic0RankOneFibrePresentedProducer.lean:40-43`, plus `set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false`, `set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3`; expect `maxHeartbeats` bumps (templates used 1.6M–3.2M).

`isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_of_algHom` (`Picard/Pic0RankOneNativePresentationField`)
transports a split witness *up* an arbitrary extension of its reading field.  This file
proves the converse: if the pullback of a class `ν` over `K` along a field embedding
`e : K →ₐ[k] K'` is a split witness, then `ν` itself already is.  Together the two make
the split-witness condition on a field class *intrinsic to the underlying point*, which
is exactly what lets the rank-one split locus be computed on any carrier and transported
down cover maps.

The proof splits `ν` over a finite separable `L/K` and destructures the hypothesis'
splitting `L'/K'`, presents both Čech classes by basic-open cocycle data, and compares
them over a common finite separable extension `P/L'`: a field factor of the base change
to `L'` of the field cover `L/K`.  Over `P` the two presenting classes agree — both
present the pushforward of `ν`, and the plus unit (étale separatedness, C1) together
with `relPicMk`-injectivity at a one-point base identifies them at the Čech level — so
the witness `H¹`-vanishing predicates of the two data coincide there, and field-location
invariance walks the witness from `L'` down to `L`.

The auxiliary finite map `pi` is used only to choose the basic-open cocycle data through
which the `H¹` witness is transported.
-/

open TopologicalSpace Opposite

-- larger budget, exactly as in the upward-transport template.
/-- **Split-witness descent along an arbitrary field embedding** — the converse of
`isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_of_algHom`: if the pullback of `ν` along

compared over a finite separable field factor of the base change of the `ν`-side
splitting field, where étale separatedness identifies the presenting Čech classes, and
the witness then descends by field-location invariance of the `H¹` predicate. -/
theorem isSplitWitness_of_overSpecMap
    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    {K K' : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Field K'] [Algebra k K']
    (e : K →ₐ[k] K') (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    (h : IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu)) :

  letI := hkL

  letI := hLfin

    change algebraMap L' P (algebraMap k L' x)

    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K' L']
  letI hKP : Algebra K P := ((algebraMap L' P).comp (algebraMap K L')).toAlgebra
  haveI htowKL'P : IsScalarTower K L' P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

    change algebraMap L' P (algebraMap k L' x)

    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K L']
  haveI htowKK'P : IsScalarTower K K' P := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
